page.layout: One printed page: running head at top; one text column with marginal notes at right (numbers 4 and 5 beside the text) and fragments of a facing page cut off at the left edge. Footer shows a catchword-like word "deniqi" at lower right, which is a continuation of the last line.

main_text.l: Materia, inquit, duplex est, ut cum
ra cælestis: prima est panis & vinum: se-
vulgo nomine signi, hanc vero nomine
symbolorum ad res significatas, eamque ponit
Porro quia ad formale referuntur ritus
cienda: iuntenim alii eorum ab ipso
Christo tum usurpati, tum ad imitationem
nobis propositi: alii vero ab hominibus
tum ob Christi pronunciatum Matth. 15. v. 9. sine causa
& mandata hominum: ut sint ita vani ejus-
modi ritus: tum quia conjuncti cum jugo servitutis legis
ceremonialis in tanta multitudine, contraria leni jugo Christi, cujus
sarcina levis est in ritibus numero pauciss-
præstantissimis, ut utar verbis Augustini: cum deniqi

page.notes: Left margin shows fragments of the facing page (partly illegible). The word "deniqi" at the foot is cut off and probably reads "deniqi[ue]" in the original; "significatione" and "præstantissimis" are partly obscured by damage. Marginal numbers 4 and 5 are references standing beside the text.
